result:
To determine your personality type, I'll need you to answer a series of questions. Please rate each of the following statements on a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree):

1. I am the life of the party.
2. I sympathize with others' feelings.
3. I get chores done before being asked.
4. I have a rich inner life and frequent daydreams.
5. I am relaxed most of the time.
6. I am not interested in people.
7. I am not interested in others' problems.
8. I often procrastinate.
9. I have difficulty making decisions.
10. I get stressed out easily.

Please provide your answers as a list of integers.

message.content: What type of personality am I?

function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.
